title: Alefay Kombil
subtitle: Front-end Developer
text: Front End Developer with experience across back end and API work, building complete and reliable web solutions using JavaScript, PHP, React, NextJS, NodeJS and CMS platforms. I turn ideas and wireframes into functional products that solve real business needs while applying practical UI/UX skills gained through hands on project work. My early career outside IT shaped the discipline and communication style I bring to tech today, and I continue to work with startups and small to medium businesses in Papua New Guinea to deliver modern and practical digital experiences as I grow in an evolving tech space.
